formulations.Polymer system Notes: Statistical copolymer poly[(ethylene oxide)-stat-(allyl glycidyl ether)] post-functionalized via thiol-ene click chemistry with N-(2-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)propyl)-4-mercaptobutanamide to give pendant, neutral, nitrogen-linked imidazole ligands (PIGE). Backbone is PEO323-stat-(imidazole-functionalized AGE)79, mole fraction of imidazole units x_IGE=0.17. Neat polymer (r=0, no metal salt). DSC (Fig. S3, not reproduced here) shows amorphous behavior, consistent with suppression of PEO crystallization by the atactic backbone.
formulations.Notes: Baseline neat PIGE (r=[M]:[Im]=0.0). Table 1: sigma at 70C = 1.0 +/- 0.49 uS/cm; sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=57C) = 0.47 +/- 0.21 uS/cm (temperature not a standard bucket, omitted). PDI reported as D<1.2.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE (imidazole-functionalized PEO-stat-PAGE, x_IGE=0.17) mixed with LiTFSI at molar ratio r=[Li+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Monovalent LiTFSI. Rheology (Fig. 3) shows only slight increase in G' and no clear plateau (no strong physical cross-linking), consistent with Li+ interacting with only one imidazole or fast M-L exchange; zero-frequency viscosity eta0 lowest of series (~0.3 kPa s per abstract; precise Fig. 5 value ambiguous on log-log plot, not extracted). Table 1 sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=58C) = 8.1 +/- 0.35 uS/cm (not a standard temperature bucket, omitted).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Ni(TFSI)2 at molar ratio r=[Ni2+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Ni2+ salt; strongest transient cross-linker of series - Fig. 3a,b show clear rubbery plateau in G' and peak in G'' within accessible frequency window; Fig. 3c/5 show largest zero-frequency viscosity increase (~100 kPa s per abstract for Ni2+); precise eta0 not extracted due to ambiguous log-log digitization. Ionic conductivity nonetheless comparable to Li+ system. Table 1 sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=61C) = 9.3 +/- 0.92 uS/cm (non-standard temperature, omitted).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Cu(TFSI)2 (Alfa Aesar source) at molar ratio r=[Cu2+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Cu2+ salt, Alfa Aesar (AA) source. Rheology shows only slight G' increase (no plateau) despite known Cu2+-imidazole M-L bond formation. Table 1 sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=59C) = 10 +/- 0.73 uS/cm (non-standard temperature, omitted). Subtle vendor-dependent differences noted between AA and Solvionic salts (see paired Solvionic entry).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Cu(TFSI)2 (Solvionic source) at molar ratio r=[Cu2+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Cu2+ salt, Solvionic (S) source; higher Tg than AA-sourced Cu2+ salt at same r, attributed to vendor-dependent salt purity differences. Conductivity at 65C corresponds to Table 1's printed value at T-Tg=90K (Tg=-25C, T=65C): 10 +/- 1.1 uS/cm.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Zn(TFSI)2 (Alfa Aesar source) at molar ratio r=[Zn2+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Zn2+ salt, Alfa Aesar (AA) source. Highest measured conductivity of r=0.1 series along with Cu2+(AA). Table 1 sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=62C) = 13 +/- 0.33 uS/cm (non-standard temperature, omitted). At reduced temperature T-Tg=66.7K, sigma_Zn/sigma_Li ~1.9 (Table 2).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Zn(TFSI)2 (Solvionic source) at molar ratio r=[Zn2+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Zn2+ salt, Solvionic (S) source; higher Tg than AA-sourced Zn2+ salt at same r. Conductivity at 65C corresponds to Table 1's printed T-Tg=90K value (Tg=-25C -> T=65C): 13 +/- 1.1 uS/cm.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Fe(TFSI)3 at molar ratio r=[Fe3+]:[Im]=0.1.
formulations.Notes: Trivalent Fe3+ salt, highest salt wt% at fixed r due to stoichiometry of 3 TFSI- anions per cation. Rheology (Fig. 3a,b) shows clear rubbery plateau/peak similar to Ni2+, indicating transient network formation. Table 1 sigma at T-Tg=90K (T=62C) = 7.6 +/- 0.70 uS/cm (non-standard temperature, omitted).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with LiTFSI at lower molar ratio r=[Li+]:[Im]=0.083, used for solid-state 1H-7Li 2D HETCOR NMR, PFG-NMR diffusion, and chronoamperometric transference number measurements.
formulations.Transference notes: t+ = 0.19 at 80C from 7Li/19F PFG-NMR diffusion coefficients via dilute-solution-theory eq (6); confirmed by Bruce-Vincent chronoamperometry (symmetric Li|electrolyte|Li coin cell, eq 1) giving t+ = 0.18 at 80C.
formulations.Notes: 1H-7Li HETCOR (Fig. 2) shows Li+ preferentially proximal to imidazole protons over PEO-backbone protons. Fig. 7b: both Li+ and TFSI- diffusion required to match measured sigma via Nernst-Einstein eq. Salt wt% and Tg for this r-ratio not reported in main text (only r=0.1 tabulated in Table 1).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Zn(TFSI)2 (Alfa Aesar source) at lower molar ratio r=[Zn2+]:[Im]=0.083, used for 19F PFG-NMR TFSI- diffusion measurements.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Zn2+ (AA), r=0.083. Fig. 6: D_TFSI- overlaps with LiTFSI-PIGE and Zn(S)-PIGE after Tg-normalization, despite 2x anion conc. vs LiTFSI, implying anion mobility set by Tg not cation identity/conc. Values not extracted numerically (overlapping log-scale series). Conductivity data only in SI Fig. S11.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE mixed with Zn(TFSI)2 (Solvionic source) at lower molar ratio r=[Zn2+]:[Im]=0.083, used for 19F PFG-NMR TFSI- diffusion and conductivity comparison with Nernst-Einstein predictions.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Zn2+ (S), r=0.083. Fig. 7d: measured conductivity (50-80C) exceeds prediction from TFSI- diffusion alone, implying mobile Zn2+ contributes; assuming full dissociation, required D_Zn2+ lower bound ~3e-9 cm2/s at 80C (t+~0.13). Zn2+ diffusion not directly measurable (paramagnetic broadening). Precise sigma/D values not extracted (plot ambiguity); salt purity >99% confirmed by XRF/NMR/KF titration.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Precursor allyl-functionalized copolymer poly[(ethylene oxide)-stat-(allyl glycidyl ether)] (PEO-stat-PAGE), prior to imidazole click functionalization, mixed with LiTFSI at r=[Li+]:[AGE]=0.083 (same backbone monomer ratio as PIGE, x_AGE=0.17, but allyl side groups instead of imidazole).
formulations.Transference notes: t+ = 0.15 at 75C, from 7Li/19F PFG-NMR diffusion coefficients via dilute-solution-theory eq (6). Lower than analogous PIGE-LiTFSI (t+=0.19 at 80C), attributed to Li+ being more tightly solvated by backbone ether-oxygens.
formulations.Notes: r defined relative to unreacted allyl glycidyl ether content, not a true coordinating ligand; 'Li:functional group' left null. Fig. 7a: measured conductivity overestimated by Nernst-Einstein prediction, indicating incomplete salt dissociation/ion pairing (unlike PIGE-LiTFSI where prediction matches). Precise sigma/D values not extracted (plot ambiguity). Salt wt% and Tg not reported for this system.
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Precursor PEO-stat-PAGE (before imidazole click functionalization) mixed with Zn(TFSI)2 (Alfa Aesar source) at r=[Zn2+]:[AGE]=0.083.
formulations.Notes: Divalent Zn2+ (AA), r=0.083, precursor polymer. Fig. 7c: measured conductivity overestimated by Nernst-Einstein prediction (TFSI- alone), indicating incomplete dissociation, worse than LiTFSI case. D_TFSI- does not collapse onto Tg-normalized master curve with PIGE-Zn systems (SI Fig. S9), suggesting ion-ion interactions affect anion mobility here. Precise sigma/D values not extracted (plot ambiguity).
formulations.Reference: Schauser, N. S.; Sanoja, G. E.; Bartels, J. M.; Jain, S. K.; Hu, J. G.; Han, S.; Walker, L. M.; Helgeson, M. E.; Seshadri, R.; Segalman, R. A. Chem. Mater. 2018, 30, 5759-5769.
